_: Swedish Military Intelligence and Security Service (MUST)
The PATRIOT Act allows agencies to collect a vast amount of data, including call records and emails.

The German Federal Constitutional Protection Act allows intelligence agencies to infiltrate foreign service providers to access relevant information. It also allows the decryption of encrypted messages.
The Investigatory Powers Act allows for the bulk collection of internet records and requires internet service providers (ISPs) to keep user logs of websites.
The French Intelligence Act 2015 allows intelligence agencies to lay telephone or internet wiretaps, exploit computer networks, and access metadata.
Italy’s Anti-terrorism law includes provisions enabling intelligence agencies to lay wiretaps and share data for national security purposes.
The Data Retention Law allows national intelligence agencies to access user logs retained by TSPs and ISPs.
The Anti-Terrorism Act establishes the CSE’s mandate, which includes acquiring and using information from the global information infrastructure for intelligence and surveillance activities.
The Telecommunications Interception and Access Act allows intelligence agencies to intercept and access stored communications with a proper warrant.
The Intelligence and Security Services Act 2017 allows agencies to intercept communications, hack third parties, and decrypt files.
Belgium’s Data Retention Act required ISPs and TSPs to retain user activity logs. However, the Act was struck down by Parliament.
Sweden’s Data Collection Act grants the Swedish Security Service the power to obtain logs from TSPs and ISPs and decrypt electronic communication.
Denmark has ratified the European Union’s Directive on Data Retention. Resultantly, telephone providers and ISPs have to log user data, including their IP address.
The Norwegian Intelligence Service Act 2020 empowers the NIS to collect information with third parties for the purpose of bilateral/multilateral collaboration.
The Intelligence and Security Act 2017 empowers surveillance agencies to collect and analyze data in keeping with government priorities.
